annotations.title: Build a sheet on the TrackerHacker starter

description: Builds a track's sheet on the TrackerHacker starter, the base for a template instead of a blank sheet, or updates it to the newest starter. Adds only the tabs it lacks (a Start here cover the author writes, Settings with setting, value and what it does, Glance and To do), sets TrackerHacker's theme the first time only, and records the starter's version in the sheet. It never changes a tab the sheet has. start_tracking with forSharing already does this. Tell the author they brand it with Format > Theme in Google Sheets (their template's page takes its accent color) and by writing their own words on Start here. check: true only says which starter version the sheet is on and what updating would add. Google Sheets only.

check.description: true reads the version and the update without changing the sheet.
